description: balance: the balance, the key's spending limits and what it spent. receipt: what one call was charged (request_id). usage: calls and charges by day, capability, key_id, entry, source or end_user (since, until, group_by). status: which capabilities are up, no key needed. Free.

group_by.description: For usage: day, capability, key_id, entry, source, end_user, comma-separated; day when left out.

request_id.description: For receipt: the call's request ID (its result ID).

since.description: For usage: from this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO time; 30 days back when left out.

until.description: For usage: up to this date (the whole day) or ISO time; now when left out.

what.description: balance with a key, status without one, when left out.

name: account
title: Account, receipts, usage and status
